dataset: Coding-agent model prices, next to their agent-arena rank
attribution: CC BY 4.0. Reuse it however you like, including commercially; the one condition is a credit that names this dataset and links to dataset_url. source below is where the list prices came from, not this dataset — the effective_per_million and vendor_checked fields are computed here and are not in the upstream catalog.

agent_token_mix.note: One person's measurement of one coding agent. Recompute with your own mix; the inputs are all here.

long_context_pricing.note: When the prompt reaches long_context_from, every token in that request bills at the long_* rate — including the tokens below the threshold. Not marginal pricing.
